output.question: Who is the parent company of Bath & Body Works?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, Bath & Body Works is operated by Bath & Body Works, Inc., which is an independent public company rather than a subsidiary of a separate parent company. The company’s official site says L Brands separated Victoria’s Secret and Bath & Body Works in August 2021, and the latest SEC annual report identifies Bath & Body Works, Inc. as the registrant and refers to it as the Company. Thus, if “parent company” means the corporate owner of the Bath & Body Works brand, the answer is Bath & Body Works, Inc.; no separate current parent company was identified.

key_facts.fact: Bath & Body Works, Inc. is the registrant named in the latest opened SEC Form 10-K, and the filing says it refers to Bath & Body Works, Inc. as "we" and the "Company."
Bath & Body Works' official corporate site says that in August 2021 L Brands separated Victoria's Secret and Bath & Body Works, which became an independent public company as Bath & Body Works.
The latest SEC filing describes Bath & Body Works as the company's brand and business, including company-operated stores and e-commerce sites.
